prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Lutetium (Lu) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a chemistry laboratory with a long worktable of glass flasks, a fume hood and shelves of labelled reagent bottles
Time of day: an overcast day — soft, shadowless grey-white light; soft even light, colours calm, no hard shadows.
Light direction: two-colour light — warm indoor light on one side, cool daylight or dusk on the other.
Outfit: visual kei — a dramatic black-and-silver layered stage outfit with lace cuffs, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated on a chair.
SUPPORT: her back rests against the seat back.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small clear crystal block that flashes blue inside, set in a hard silver-white lutetium frame up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — lutetium: a hard, dense silvery-white metal, the last and smallest of the fifteen lanthanides and the hardest and densest of them; found in 1907 by a Paris chemist, also a painter and sculptor, who split the earth called ytterbia once more and named the hidden younger element for Lutetia, the old Latin name of Paris, while a rival in Austria called it cassiopeium; woven with silicon and oxygen into scintillator crystals it throws a tiny flash of blue light each time a gamma ray strikes, the eyes of PET scanners; its slow decay over some thirty-seven billion years dates meteorites and the oldest rocks — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
